from collections import Counter
# Verify the inferred rule against the three received pairs using their junction grids.
def render(nodes, base, specials):
    rs=[i for i,row in enumerate(nodes) for x in row if x in specials]
    cs=[j for row in nodes for j,x in enumerate(row) if x in specials]
    r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs); c0,c1=min(cs),max(cs)
    out=[]
    for r in range(r0,r1):
        row=[]
        for c in range(c0,c1):
            vals=[nodes[r][c],nodes[r][c+1],nodes[r+1][c],nodes[r+1][c+1]]
            n=Counter(x for x in vals if x in specials)
            best,nc=n.most_common(1)[0] if n else (base,0)
            row.append(best if nc>=3 else base)
        out.append(row)
    return out

def render_allcorners(nodes, base):
    marked={(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(nodes) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x!=base}
    if not marked:return [[base]]
    r0=min(r for r,c in marked); r1=max(r for r,c in marked)
    c0=min(c for r,c in marked); c1=max(c for r,c in marked)
    out=[]
    for r in range(r0,r1):
        row=[]
        for c in range(c0,c1):
            vals=[nodes[r][c],nodes[r][c+1],nodes[r+1][c],nodes[r+1][c+1]]
            row.append(vals[0] if vals[0]!=base and len(set(vals))==1 else base)
        out.append(row)
    # trim all-default outer rows/columns
    while out and all(x==base for x in out[0]):out.pop(0)
    while out and all(x==base for x in out[-1]):out.pop()
    while out and all(row[0]==base for row in out):
        out=[row[1:] for row in out]
    while out and all(row[-1]==base for row in out):
        out=[row[:-1] for row in out]
    return out
# demo1 lattice
n1=[[8]*6 for _ in range(7)]
for r,cs in {1:[0,1,2],2:[0,1,2,3],3:[1,2,3,4,5],4:[1,2,3,4],5:[1,2,3],6:[1,2,3]}.items():
    for c in cs:n1[r][c]=0

def render2(nodes, outbase):
    junctionbase=Counter(x for row in nodes for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    specials={x for row in nodes for x in row if x!=junctionbase}
    marked=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(nodes) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x in specials]
    r0=min(r for r,c in marked); r1=max(r for r,c in marked)
    c0=min(c for r,c in marked); c1=max(c for r,c in marked)
    out=[]
    for r in range(r0,r1):
        rr=[]
        for c in range(c0,c1):
            v=nodes[r][c]
            vals=[v,nodes[r][c+1],nodes[r+1][c],nodes[r+1][c+1]]
            rr.append(v if v in specials and len(set(vals))==1 else outbase)
        out.append(rr)
    while out and all(x==outbase for x in out[0]):out.pop(0)
    while out and all(x==outbase for x in out[-1]):out.pop()
    while out and all(row[0]==outbase for row in out):out=[row[1:] for row in out]
    while out and all(row[-1]==outbase for row in out):out=[row[:-1] for row in out]
    return out
print(render2(n1,4))
print(render2(n2,1))
print(render2(n3,9))
